days.title: High Mountain Summits and Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Rax
stops.detail: It is arguably one of the most famous tours on the Viennese local mountain, the Rax – and certainly the most famous ascent on the Styrian side of this mountain range.

stops.name: Karl Ludwig Haus
stops.detail: Only in fog is the final part from the Karl Ludwig Haus to the Heukuppe not recommended.

stops.name: Knopperwiese
stops.detail: Interesting Alpine flora, rare wild animals such as chamois, marmot, eagle and alpine newt, a giant sinkhole at the Knopperwiese (caution!), great panoramic views at the Windberg peak.

days.title: Educational Nature Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Biodiversitätslehrpfad
stops.detail: Mürzer Oberland Nature Park is making its award-winning biodiversity trail fit for the future – renewed walkways, bridges and a largely barrier-free circular path enable an even better nature experience for people with special needs.

stops.name: Wald der Sinne
stops.detail: The Forest of the Senses is located on the mountain farm of the Holzer family, also known as Steinwandtner, in Neuberg/Mürz in the middle of the Mürzer Oberland Nature Park.

stops.name: Erlebnisweg klimawandeln
stops.detail: The 'klimawandeln' discovery trail focuses on the topics of biodiversity and nature conservation at 14 adventure stations, each with a specific habitat reference.

stops.name: Tirolbach
stops.detail: In hot temperatures, a dip in the Tirolbach is a welcome refreshment.
